front: What does shape [batch, time, features] mean?
back: Axis 0: examples processed together. Axis 1: time steps per example. Axis 2: values per step.

front: How many sliding windows fit in a series of length T?
back: T − input_len − horizon + 1, when the stride is 1. Zero if the series is too short.
A view of all windows on the same memory. Nothing is copied until you call .copy().

front: Why leave a gap between train and validation windows?
back: Overlapping windows share values. The gap stops information from leaking from validation into training.

front: Where do you compute scaling statistics?
back: On the training part only. Then apply the same numbers to validation and test.
